title: transit: SQLite pool max_connections hardcoded at 8
description: Why: SqlitePoolOptions::new().max_connections(8) in main.rs:414 (open_pool) is hardcoded for both the core and transit pools. Operators on low-resource hardware or high-concurrency deployments have no way to tune this.\n\nWhat: Add database.max_connections (default 8) to TransitConfig; pass to open_pool(). Same pattern should be applied to the mail and reader binaries.
